{{Quote|That's the ''least'' of our worries right now, boss! We've fallen out of hyperspace in the middle of nowhere. There's a moon that'll support life...if we can make it there in one piece.|The pirate, to his boss Lumbra|<ref name="DT 8" />}}
A '''pirate''' of the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] worked under the [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Lumbra]] aboard [[Lumbra's ship]]. This pirate aided Lumbra after they double-crossed their former boss [[Haka Hai]] and took the supposed [[Dreypa's Oubliette|Jebble Box]] for themselves&mdash;however, the box had been sabotaged by its owner [[Schurk-Heren]], and when opened it blew up part of the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] and caused Lumbra's team to crash on a [[Unidentified jungle moon (K'Kruhk)|jungle moon]].<ref name="DT 8" /> The Devaronian joined Lumbra as they attempted to salvage from a crashed [[Theta-class T-2c shuttle/Legends|''Theta''-class]] [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] being used as a [[K'Kruhk's camp|base]] by the [[Soaring Hawkbat Clan]].<ref name="DT 9">[[Dark Times 9|''Dark Times'' 9]]</ref>

The pirate met their end with the rest of Lumbra's crew when they were [[Skirmish on unidentified jungle moon|attacked]] by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[K'Kruhk]], who had been caring for the Soaring Hawkbat Clan when the pirates attacked.<ref name="DT 10">[[Dark Times 10|''Dark Times'' 10]]</ref>
